# T-053 RLS audit (migration 0038)

Fresh rls-auditor subagent in its own worktree. Tests it wrote: `supabase/tests/t053-rls.test.ts` (24 tests; the three gap tests are now plain tests proving the fixes). `check-migrations`: 0038 is the next number, journalled, no applied migration edited.

| Object / action                                                     | anon       | member A                                   | admin A    | B            | left A       |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------- | ------------------------------------------ | ---------- | ------------ | ------------ |
| notifications SELECT                                                | denied     | own rows                                   | own rows   | own rows     | none         |
| notifications INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE                                  | denied     | denied                                     | denied     | denied       | denied       |
| sender_user_id, recipient_email, email_*, dedupe_key                | denied     | denied (also via `n.*`, `to_jsonb`, WHERE) | denied     | denied       | denied       |
| mark_notifications_read                                             | denied     | own only                                   | own only   | own only     | 0            |
| task_notes SELECT                                                   | denied     | yes                                        | yes        | no           | no           |
| task_notes UPDATE body / DELETE                                     | denied     | author only                                | no         | no           | no           |
| task_notes other columns / INSERT                                   | denied     | denied                                     | denied     | denied       | denied       |
| task_note_mentions SELECT                                           | denied     | yes                                        | yes        | no           | no           |
| add_task_note, message_admins, remind_debt, handover_next_recipient | denied     | yes                                        | yes        | not_a_member | not_a_member |
| internal and trigger functions                                      | no execute | no execute                                 | no execute | no execute   | no execute   |

Trigger probes: B and a leaver can't touch A's stays, handovers, invitations or guest requests; a plain member can't confirm stays, decide requests or invite; a stay pointed at B's member never notifies them; the 0034 guard stops redirecting a guest request to an outsider's sign-in.

| Gap       | Finding                                                                                                                           | Fix in 0038                                                                                                               |
| --------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| G1        | A plain member could file a handover as another member; the leaving-checklist e-mail then came "from" them with the member's note | Handover insert and update policies: `member_id` is your own unless you're an admin, and `submitted_at` not in the future |
| G2        | A handover could name a member of account B; their name reached A's notification                                                  | The author's name is read only within the cottage's account                                                               |
| G3        | An admin of A could invite with B's cottage id; B's cottage name went into the e-mail                                             | Cottage and inviter names read only within the invitation's account                                                       |
| Note      | A future-dated handover could hold back forwarding of the real one                                                                | Covered by the G1 date check                                                                                              |
| Allowlist | Reasons for notify_on_handover, notify_on_invitation, notify_on_guest_request incomplete; notify_enqueue missing                  | Reasons rewritten; entry added                                                                                            |

Not proven: real Supabase behaviour (PGlite harness with shims), the service-role cron route, real sending. An admin can still rewrite `guest_email` before deciding (like invitations, capped).
